prs.cluster_pick_reason: Implements a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper that does proper per-entry Accept header parsing: splits on commas, trims/lowercases each media-range, strips parameters, and explicitly excludes entries with q=0, plus type/subtype comparison (with wildcard handling). Same underlying fix, but #1996's implementation is more spec-correct and testable in isolation via the extracted helper.
